_note: USD per million tokens, list price (standard tier). Provider prices change: verify before relying on an estimate, and pass --prices <file> to override or add models. A model with no entry here or in --prices makes the run refuse to start rather than be priced at zero. Matching is the exact id, or a dated snapshot of it (<id>-YYYYMMDD or <id>@...); any other variant is unpriced, including OpenAI's dashed-date snapshots (<id>-YYYY-MM-DD) and -pro/-mini variants. The ids bundled for each provider are listed under that provider's entry in `sources`, together with the page URL and the date the prices below were verified against it; supply any other provider or model with --prices.

anthropic.tier: Standard, text tokens, USD per 1M tokens
anthropic.caveat: claude-haiku-5-5 is priced by PROMPT LENGTH, which this table cannot express. The entry below is the up-to-100,000-token tier (0.1 / 0.5). Prompts over 100,000 tokens bill at 0.5 / 2.5 per 1M tokens, so an estimate for a payload that large under-states the bound by 5x. For a tools/list payload near or over that threshold, pass --prices with the higher tier.
